glosses: Of or pertaining to a lack of attention; not paying attention; careless.

examples.text: He was inattentive in class and did not do well in his exams.

glosses: Qui n’a pas d’attention.

examples.text: Le poète, inattentif aux yeux effroyables de la vampire, se tenait donc inébranlablement assuré de posséder à vil prix un logis de prince.
